chart_payloads.title: Dissolved-oxygen sag - Eel River near Scotia, California
chart_payloads.caption: DO sag: minimum 8.3828 mg/L at 38.1 m downstream (meets the 5 mg/L standard, red dashed). CBOD decay drives the sag; reaeration recovers it. The Streeter-Phelps closed form is drawn beside it on this run's own mix point, load and velocity - whole-profile RMS 0.6797 mg/L, sag minimum 0.1146 mg/L above it. Screening/permit grade.
